method: Ran the dependency-free audit script. It compiled and executed the lesson Python fence with a synthetic model response, confirming the local loop executes a requested delete_all fake sink without an authorization gate. It also asserted that injection scope, historical model outputs, boundary labels, keyword filters and official source references are described with explicit limits.
limitations: The script does not call a model, provider or external tool and cannot reproduce the historical 2026-10-09 or chapter 2 model observations.

The audit checks the lesson wording and code boundary; it does not validate a production input classifier, source provenance pipeline, retention policy, authorization service, or human approval workflow.
Anthropic tool-result guidance applies to its API and should not be generalized to other providers; OWASP recommendations are mitigations rather than proof of prevention.
